reason: The actual repeated running-LCM series remains undecided. A moving-phase a^(|P|-1) leading asymptotic, interval of normalized limits on each arithmetic progression and exclusion of finite polynomial/quasipolynomial corrections do not exclude arbitrary nonpolynomial integer carries under rationality. At three primes the error is o(a^2), not fractional-part control or o(1). The proof explicitly exhibits a rounded integral sequence with the same leading profile, without claiming it satisfies the true recurrence; no residue-escape theorem, irrationality proof or rational counterexample is supplied. Singleton supports and duplicate-removed variants are separate.
